groups.description: Aim teleport, measurement, moon boost and FPS history. Delayed equipment or FPS-registration replies cannot undo a later spectator request or supersede a newer spawn. The moon runner uses the shared isolated-server harness and reports script/engine hashes. Moon reset contacts queue immediately and cannot schedule a stale load after another player action; non-player and dead actors are rejected. Measurement uses the shared runner, current engine selection and an actual spawnpoint on the selected map.
groups.requires: Initialized Compose, matching engine, game/compiled mod and relevant maps; FPS history compiles a plugin. Aim-teleport coordinates require mp_dark.
groups.effects: Isolated fixture servers, synthetic players and private logs; no gameplay database.
